verdict.rationale: Apify says it works with headless-browser automation tools (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium) and its own Crawlee browser automation library, which implies developers can render JavaScript-heavy pages in Actors. The pack also shows calling the apify/web-scraper Actor programmatically, but nothing explicitly documents SPA rendering or returning the fully rendered HTML. Missing for 10: explicit docs on rendering SPAs and returning rendered HTML, a documented browser-based rendering Actor or endpoint, and independent or hands-on confirmation of JS rendering.
